rows.label: Flat LUK
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: LUK %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: DEX
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 LUK = 1 Attack, 1 DEX = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: FINAL_DAMAGE % (multiplicative source)
rows.semantics: the +1% multiplicative step bumps the whole Final Damage bucket, including the live Dark Evasion share (Current / New include it)

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Agile Throwing's (Attack Speed), Physical Training's (Basic Attack Damage), Throwing Mastery's (Min Damage) and Critical Throw's (Crit Rate, Crit Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Enveloping Darkness' (Boss Damage) and Spirit Projection's (Attack %) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Vitality Siphon's (Attack %), Throwing Expert's (Skill Damage, Max Damage) and Dark Blessing's (Final Damage, Defense Penetration) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Agile Throwing, Physical Training, Throwing Mastery, Critical Throw, Enveloping Darkness, Spirit Projection, Vitality Siphon, Throwing Expert, Dark Blessing)
